meta.title: Shopfront
meta.description: Your posts and review replies, written for you.

enter.label: Passphrase
enter.wrong: That passphrase isn't right. Try again.

home.signedIn: Signed in on this phone for 30 days.

panel.warnWhatsapp: Add your WhatsApp number: every post ends with it.
panel.warnTown: Add your town: posts and hashtags use it.
panel.thin: We couldn't read much from your website. Fill in what's missing so your posts are right.

fields.name: Name
fields.highlights: What your site says about you

panel.searching: Looking up what people search for…
panel.searchFailed: We couldn't look this up today. We'll try again next time.

edit.englishHint: Write in English: your posts are in English.

errors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like a link.
errors.invalidPhone: That doesn't look like a phone number.
errors.needCountryCode: Start with your country code, like +84 or +62.
errors.styleIncomplete: Fill in all five, or leave them all empty.

home.readHint: We read a few pages and your photos. It takes about 20 seconds.
home.keepOpen: Keep this page open for about 20 seconds.
home.intro: This is what we understood about {name}. Fix anything that's wrong: your posts are written from it.
home.invalidSaved: We couldn't open your saved business. Read your website again.
home.notKept: This browser won't keep your business: you'll need to read your site again next time.

errors.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a website address. Check it and try again.
errors.blocked_address: We can't read that address. Use your website's public link.
errors.unreachable: We couldn't open your website. Check the address, or try again in a few minutes.
errors.robots_disallowed: Your website asks apps not to read it, so we can't. Contact us and we'll help you set up.
errors.model_busy: Shopfront has used today's free reading. Try again tomorrow.
errors.model_timeout: Reading your website took too long. Try again.
errors.model_failed: Something went wrong while reading your website. Try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. We'll carry on when you're back.

reread.title: Read your website again?
reread.body: Your {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} will be replaced by what your site says now.

forget.title: Forget {name}?
forget.body: This deletes everything Shopfront keeps on this phone for your business. You can read your website again any time.

posts.moreBelow: They go on top. Attempt {n} stays below.
posts.empty: Each suggestion is 2 images (1 for the post, 1 for the story) and the text for the post, ready for Instagram. Pick the ones you like and save them to your phone.
posts.emptyTextOnly: Each suggestion is the text for a post, ready for Instagram. Pick the ones you like and copy them.
posts.howTo: In Instagram: make a post with the post image and paste the text, then a story with the story image.
posts.howToTextOnly: In Instagram: make a post with your own photo and paste the text.
posts.keepOpen: Keep this page open for about a minute while your posts are made.

flags.price: This price isn't on your website: {text}. Check it before posting.
flags.duration: This duration isn't on your website: {text}. Check it before posting.
flags.banned: Instagram may not allow "{text}". Better to change it.

posts.stale: Your business details changed since these posts were made.
posts.staleEdited: Posts you edited stay as you wrote them.
posts.updating: Updating your captions to match your business…

errors.model_busy: Shopfront has used today's free writing. Try again tomorrow.
errors.model_timeout: Writing your posts took too long. Try again.
errors.model_failed: Something went wrong while writing your posts. Try again.
errors.invalid_profile: Something went wrong while writing your posts. Try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Your posts will carry on when you're back.

images.off: Images aren't turned on for your account yet.

errors.images_paused: Images are paused for now. Your captions are ready.
errors.image_blocked: This image couldn't be made. Try again for a new one.
errors.image_timeout: This image took too long. Try again.
errors.image_failed: Something went wrong while making this image.
errors.invalid_request: Something went wrong while making this image.
errors.no_space: Your phone is out of space for images.
errors.offline: You're offline. Your images will carry on when you're back.

edit.caption: Caption
edit.hashtagsHint: Up to 5. Separate them with spaces.
edit.tooLong: Too long for Instagram: {count} characters over.

errors.model_busy: Shopfront has used today's free translations. Try again tomorrow.
errors.model_timeout: The translation took too long. Try again.
errors.model_failed: Something went wrong with the translation. Try again.

reviews.intro: Got a new review on Google Maps? Copy it and paste it here. We write 2 replies in your guest's language.
reviews.keepOpen: Keep this page open for a few seconds.
reviews.heading: {name}'s review · in {language}
reviews.abusive: This review may be abusive or fake. It can be better not to reply, or to report it in Google Maps. If you reply, keep it calm, like below.
reviews.howTo: In Google Maps: open the review, tap Reply and paste.
